measurement_source: One IDF-derived representative wall, not a field measurement
transfer: Same material construction and nominal area for all 105 candidates; variable effective area scales G and C together. No target-pair geometry enters fitting.
uncertainty: Area ranges are analyst-declared sensitivity assumptions, not measured uncertainty intervals.
pruning: Each interzone G belongs to {0} union [Gmin,Gmax]. Sparsity penalty lambda sum G applies only to interzone branches.
solver: Multistart cyclic exact-coordinate minimization; nonconvex disjunctive feasible set, no global optimum guarantee. Unpenalized bounded refit of every discovered support.
selection: For each area range: fewest states then active conductances within .02 deg C of lowest validation 24h RMSE.
evaluation: Same existing train/validation/test blocks, 72h causal conditioning, realized inputs, exact discretization; reused test periods are exploratory.
